hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook that integrates Uniswap v4 with Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes swap amounts using a proprietary bonding curve, takes input tokens from the PoolManager and deposits them into an Euler vault, then withdraws output tokens from a paired Euler vault and settles via BeforeSwapDelta. Direct liquidity additions and donations are blocked.
